items.stem: An AppSheet app repeatedly loads the wrong record when users tap a row. The most likely cause is:

options.text: The table's row key is not unique
options.rationale: Correct: AppSheet needs a unique key to identify each row reliably.
The number of views does not affect row identity.

options.text: The Sheet has a header row
options.rationale: A header row is expected and normal.

options.text: Gemini was not used to build it
options.rationale: Record identity depends on keys, not on AI assistance.

items.explanation: Correct: AppSheet needs a unique key to identify each row reliably.

items.stem: Gemini drafts an AppSheet expression for a validation rule. Before using it you should:

options.text: Test it against sample rows including edge cases
options.rationale: Correct: generated logic must be verified against real and edge-case data.

options.text: Deploy it to all users immediately
options.rationale: Deploying unverified logic risks breaking data capture.

options.text: Assume it is correct because it compiled
options.rationale: Compiling does not prove the logic is right.
Sample data is needed to test the rule.

items.explanation: Correct: generated logic must be verified against real and edge-case data.

items.stem: Which TWO are good governance practices before rolling out an operational app? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Restrict edit access by user role
options.rationale: Correct: least-privilege access protects operational data.

options.text: Validate required fields and data types
options.rationale: Correct: validation keeps the captured data trustworthy.
Owner rights for all violates least privilege.
Skipping testing risks shipping broken workflows.

items.explanation: Correct: role-based access and field validation are core governance steps before rollout.
